description: Urban Green DaMS: Bioretention Column Detention Data is a data set deposited in ORDA - The University of Sheffield Research Data Catalogue and Repository by its authors Simon De-Ville, Virginia Stovin. This dataset is a complete record of all data compiled as part of a series of five controlled inflow tests to identify the detention behaviour in a series of differently configured bioretention columns. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 22884665 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
